content_fields.title: Implement application and webhook security strategies (GitHub)
content_fields.description: Apply the platform's application and webhook security controls to this repository.
content_fields.guidance: Installed applications should be limited to those reviewed and needed, granted least-privilege scopes; webhooks should use a strong shared secret, deliver only over HTTPS, and have their payload signatures verified by every receiver.
content_fields.found: The repository contains no .github directory, no workflow definitions and no webhook receivers.
content_fields.missing: The source-control platform's organization and repository settings, which are not represented as files in the repository.
content_fields.conclusion: Application installations and webhook configuration live in the hosting platform's settings, not in versioned repository content.
content_fields.action: The repository administrators should review installed applications and webhook configuration in the platform settings.
